raw_blocks: Well-being through the power of cannabis.
At Green Thumb, we believe in the plant’s potential to improve health, happiness, and comfort. We invest in our people, our brands, and our retail experiences to power a profound shift in well-being.
The gold standard for green
Since 2014, we’ve championed brands that give people choice in safe and quality cannabis on their journey to well-being.
A growing team with deep roots

At Green Thumb, we believe in creating a more inclusive cannabis culture, shaping the industry in a way that makes all of us proud and normalizing well-being through the power of the plant. As we continue to grow, our shared values keep us grounded—we are humble, hardworking, grateful people who value transparency and integrity.

As a team, we strive to create lasting, positive change in the communities we serve. Our Growing for Good social impact program is how we put our beliefs into practice and focus on four key pillars of progress: Restorative Justice, Inclusion & Belonging, Environmental Stewardship and Community Engagement.

raw_blocks: We believe everyone has a right to well-being

In 2014, we founded Green Thumb with a mission to promote well-being through the power of cannabis. As a national consumer packaged goods company and retailer, we’ve always strived to create the most authentic cannabis brands and consumer experiences while treating people well and giving back to the communities we serve. We’re headquartered in Chicago with operations across 14 markets, serving millions of customers and patients each year. As our company continues to grow, we stay grounded by holding ourselves to the industry’s highest possible standards.
We’re leaving our thumbprint on the industry
It’s our way of bringing humanity to an industry that’s about helping people first and foremost — and always has been.
United by shared values and a passion for the plant’s possibilities, our people create authentic cannabis experiences while giving back to the communities that welcome us.
A family of cannabis brands
Featuring high-quality products cultivated and hand-crafted by the industry’s leading experts, our expansive brand portfolio empowers consumers of all stages on their path to well- being.
As RISE expands into new communities, our retail team remains committed to creating welcoming spaces where all guests and patients from all experiences feel supported in their cannabis journey.
We acknowledge the complex history of cannabis and strive to take meaningful actions that help right the wrongs of the failed War on Drugs, while shaping a more inclusive, equitable industry.
A trusted voice in the industry
This business is all about innovation and growth—and Green Thumb remains an authentic presence at the forefront of cannabis.

Growing up, my grandfather sparked my imagination and appreciation for puzzles and problem solving. We learned that if one could “remove all assumptions” and stay open to possibilities, it could lead to new ways of thinking and often interesting solutions.
At Green Thumb, we are here because we believe deeply in a new way of well-being. We believe strongly that cannabis can enable that change and that we can achieve it by working together.

Before this business existed, I voted for Prop 215 while going to school in California back in 1996. This was the country’s first ballot initiative to pass and legalize medical marijuana statewide. It was a privilege to be part of this American process.

Since then, the end of cannabis prohibition has fascinated me. I studied the parallels with the repeal of alcohol prohibition in the 1930’s. It became clear that in fact, “history does not repeat, it rhymes.” – Mark Twain. We were entering Prohibition 2.0.

We have a once in a lifetime opportunity to create something important: to provide access to a product that can curb the opioid epidemic, to create jobs, to generate tax revenue to fund underfunded education programs, and most importantly, to help people live happier, healthier, more comfortably.
This progress starts and ends with people. People who believe in change. People who believe in what we do. In short, people like you.

We are grateful to those who have done this hard work before us. They have made it possible for us to exist. They remind us that when others are wary, we can be bold. We can remove all assumptions to do things differently – how would we want to have done it if we’re going to do it forever – and help even more people along the way.
Thank you for joining our journey to well-being.

raw_blocks: We win because of the team

Whether harvesting flower or helping a guest find the perfect product at one of our stores, our people leave their unique thumbprint across the company. What unites us all today, tomorrow and twenty years from now is our passion for the plant and people’s well-being.

To be an "employee" of GTI I feel is an understatement. We are a family filled with talented amazing people and daily we uplift and radiate positivity within our facility. A culture created that is ultimately life changing to many. Before working at Green Thumb, I've always felt as if I had to prove myself, but since becoming a member of this community I've learned that is not the case. The opportunities to grow within Green Thumb are endless. Through the leadership trainings I have been armed with the skills and the tools to become a respectful leader in this community, and the Green Thumb print will always have a lasting impression on my life. I have gained knowledge that will open opportunities that I had only dreamed of previously. The joy and fulfilment I have every day is indescribable. I carry being a member of this family as a badge of honor, and I am always proud to say I work for Green Thumb.

My experience working at GTI has been so positive and uplifting. The moment I set foot in the door, I felt comfortable being my authentic self and that my differences were celebrated instead being restrained. I love the drive and teamwork our entire facility puts forth on a daily basis. We all have different tasks to complete throughout the day, but our end goal is the same: to provide our patients with the highest quality cannabis. I have never in my life witnessed a group of people work with the same passion, drive and determination that my co-workers exhibit every day. It is truly a pleasure to work with each and every one of them, and at the end of the day, it feels good to go home, knowing that we are positively changing peoples lives!

Green Thumb has provided me a journey for personal and professional growth. I work in an environment where not knowing the answer is considered ok and being able to go create the answer is the ultimate empowerment. Green Thumb’s greatest resources are the incredible and unique people who work here. As a Talent Acquisition professional, I’ve had the privilege of trying to find these people to join our team. I’ve discovered first-hand how inclusive cannabis is to all people from every walk of life, and together, we can accomplish anything.
Interested in a career with Green Thumb?
